selection.rule: default = largest 0.05-grid floor that is lossless on BOTH the holdout (per-bucket Recall@10, semantic and hybrid, vs floor 0.00) and the frozen 100-query regression (semantic@10 and hybrid@10 vs floor 0.00), minus one grid step of margin; if no positive floor is lossless, default 0.0 (defensive path only)

honesty.note: Default backend is the bigram fuzzy lexical hash; semantic/hybrid numbers are informational and cannot license promotion. Real-E5 calibration is skipped unless a verified bundle is imported.
